description: This file defines the TimeseriesService interface for handling time series data operations such as querying, saving, and removing data entries within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: TimeseriesService
classes.description: Interface defining methods for time series data operations such as querying, saving, and deleting entries.

methods.name: findAllByQueries
methods.description: Finds all time series data matching the provided queries for a specific tenant and entity.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all time series entries matching the provided queries for a specific tenant and entity.

methods.name: findLatest
methods.description: Finds the latest time series entry for a specific tenant, entity, and key.

methods.name: findLatest
methods.description: Finds the latest time series entries for a specific tenant, entity, and collection of keys.

methods.name: findAllLatest
methods.description: Retrieves all latest time series entries for a specific tenant and entity.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a single time series entry for a specific tenant and entity.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves multiple time series entries with a TTL for a specific tenant and entity.

methods.name: saveWithoutLatest
methods.description: Saves multiple time series entries without updating latest data, with TTL.

methods.name: saveLatest
methods.description: Saves latest time series entries for a specific tenant and entity.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes time series data based on delete queries for a specific tenant and entity.

methods.name: removeLatest
methods.description: Removes latest time series data for specific keys for a tenant and entity.

methods.name: removeAllLatest
methods.description: Removes all latest time series data for a tenant and entity.

methods.name: findAllKeysByDeviceProfileId
methods.description: Finds all time series keys associated with a specific device profile.

methods.name: findAllKeysByEntityIds
methods.description: Finds all time series keys associated with a list of entity IDs.

methods.name: findAllKeysByEntityIdsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds all time series keys for a list of entity IDs.

methods.name: findLatestByEntityIds
methods.description: Retrieves latest time series entries for a list of entity IDs.

methods.name: findLatestByEntityIdsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves latest time series entries for entity IDs.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup operations with a specified system TTL.
